content: Strands Agents (python) mid-turn input: PR #913 implemented queue-input-during-running-turn (issue #855). Interrupts via @interruptable_tool + InterruptState raise InterruptException; agent response stop_reason=pause_turn; resume by re-invoking agent(result) after collecting input. agent.pause(PauseModel/PauseInput/PauseHook) + get_resume_token/resume requires a session manager for persistence.
